name: What are the alternatives to a short sale for homeowners in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What are the alternatives to a short sale for homeowners in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: For homeowners in South Florida facing financial distress, alternatives to a short sale include loan modifications, deed in lieu of foreclosure, or sometimes even refinancing if your financial situation has stabilized. A loan modification alters the terms of your existing mortgage to make payments more affordable. A deed in lieu of foreclosure involves voluntarily transferring property ownership to the lender to avoid foreclosure. This decision factor depends on your specific financial hardship, property value, and lender policies. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can discuss these options and help you weigh the pros and cons of each in your specific area, from Miami to Fort Lauderdale.
